description: An understand run over the pricing-workbook fixture (a rendered Excel workbook beside a C# helper, as an uploaded zip holding a workbook). The Pricing.xlsx task reads the formulas and the values of the Quote sheet and the workbook index (more than half of the area, so the read-more rule of P3-78 asks nothing), which hold a planted instruction in a cell, and describes the discount rule, the price lookup and the Quote sheet as an entity; the Tools task reads the helper and describes it. Written by hand for the fake provider; no real provider was called (P3-50).
